column3: BSB divides the verse and adds “room.”
BSB divides the verse and adds “stone.”
BSB adds “But we cannot” for “it is not now the time.”
BSB renders “the first tabernacle” as “the first room.”
BSB renders “to make perfect in regard to conscience” as “to cleanse the conscience.”
BSB renders “ordinances of the flesh” as “external regulations.”
BSB follows the critical text with “the good things that have come” (γενομένων); the Textus Receptus reads “that are to come.”
BSB adds “ceremonially” and renders “the purification of the flesh” as “their bodies are clean.”
BSB renders “dead works” as “works of death.”
BSB reorders the clauses and supplies “Christ.”
BSB adds “Nor did He enter heaven.”
BSB renders “apart from sin” as “not to bear sin.”
